KNUCKLES.title: Knuckles Game
KNUCKLES.setup.title: New dice game
KNUCKLES.setup.name: Name
KNUCKLES.setup.tokenTitle: Bound to this token — dice are read from and added to its inventory.
KNUCKLES.board.noGame: No game in progress. The GM can start one from the dice control or the Knuckles Game macro.
KNUCKLES.board.finalRound: Final round — the round will finish, then the highest score wins.
KNUCKLES.board.bust: Bust — no scoring dice. Spend a Hero Point to re-roll, or take the bust.
KNUCKLES.board.heroHint: Pick dice from the last roll to re-roll (one up to all six), then confirm to spend 1 Hero Point.
KNUCKLES.board.gmRerollHint: Pick the current player's dice to re-roll for free (GM only), then confirm — no Hero Point is spent.
KNUCKLES.board.endConfirm: End the game now? Nobody wins, and every collected stake goes back to its owner.
KNUCKLES.combos.title: Combinations
KNUCKLES.combos.wildText: completes any combo, scores nothing alone
KNUCKLES.dice.title: Choose your dice
KNUCKLES.dice.hint: Pick a die for each of the six slots. Dice are chosen only before the game; during play only the GM can change them.
KNUCKLES.dice.buyMore: Owns fewer than six dice — {n} will be gifted on start.
KNUCKLES.dice.stockNote: Unowned dice are stocked to this token when the game starts.
KNUCKLES.dice.saveDefaultHint: Remember these six dice as this character's default loadout (survives restarts).
KNUCKLES.dice.resetDefaultHint: Restore this character's saved default loadout.
KNUCKLES.log.hero: {name} spent a Hero Point to re-roll
KNUCKLES.settings.defaultTarget.name: Default target score
KNUCKLES.settings.defaultTarget.hint: The score new games are played to by default. Can be changed per game.
KNUCKLES.settings.npcHeroPool.name: Hero Points for generic players
KNUCKLES.settings.npcHeroPool.hint: Hero Points given to a participant entered as a name only, with no character or token. Player characters use their own sheet, and NPCs never get Hero Points. Set to 0 to give generic players none.
KNUCKLES.settings.physicalDice.name: Physical dice (item economy)
KNUCKLES.settings.physicalDice.hint: Off (default): the game uses virtual dice exactly as before. On: dice become real, buyable inventory items that a character must own to play them, using the bundled Knuckles Dice compendium. Two separate approaches — pick the one that fits your table. Takes effect on the next new game.
KNUCKLES.settings.theme.name: Board theme
KNUCKLES.settings.theme.hint: Visual theme for the game board.
KNUCKLES.settings.dieSkin.name: Dice style
KNUCKLES.settings.colorAccent.name: Accent colour
KNUCKLES.settings.colorBoard.name: Board background colour
KNUCKLES.settings.colorDie.name: Dice colour
KNUCKLES.settings.color.hint: Leave blank to use the theme default. Accepts any CSS colour, e.g. #c9a24a.
KNUCKLES.themeLang.menuHint: Set the dice theme and language for the whole table (GM only).
KNUCKLES.themeLang.hint: The theme and language apply to the whole table. Only dice names and descriptions change.
KNUCKLES.warn.needTwo: A game needs at least two players.
KNUCKLES.warn.gmOnly: Only the GM can start a game.
KNUCKLES.warn.noTokens: Select one or more tokens on the canvas first.
KNUCKLES.resume.text: An unfinished game was found: round {round}, {players} players.
KNUCKLES.resume.hint: Discarding ends it with no winner and refunds every collected stake.
KNUCKLES.stakes.title: Stakes
KNUCKLES.stakes.short: Some participants can't cover their bet.
KNUCKLES.stakes.footnote: Create adds the shortfall to the pot from nothing. Loans and bets are refunded if the game is cancelled with no winner.
KNUCKLES.board.endConfirmFinished: Clear the finished game? The pot has already been paid to the winner.
KNUCKLES.board.newConfirm: Start a new game? The current one ends with no winner, and every collected stake goes back to its owner.
KNUCKLES.gen.title: Quick hand
KNUCKLES.gen.dealHint: Deal a fresh hand to this participant. The remaining slots keep the honest die.
KNUCKLES.gen.dealAllHint: Deal to all fills NPC and generic rows; player characters are dealt only from their own row.
KNUCKLES.builder.title: Custom dice
KNUCKLES.builder.openHint: Make a die of your own: name it, give it an icon, and set the chance of each face.
KNUCKLES.builder.headHint: saved to the Items directory and every slot dropdown
KNUCKLES.builder.name: Name
KNUCKLES.builder.iconPh: Pick an image so it never wears the stock die
KNUCKLES.builder.descPh: Where it came from, how it behaves
KNUCKLES.builder.classHint: where the quick-hand generator files it
KNUCKLES.builder.facesHint: typed values lock in; empty faces split what is left
KNUCKLES.builder.poolShort: {n}% unassigned. Fill it in or clear a face
KNUCKLES.builder.noneYet: No dice made at this table yet.
KNUCKLES.builder.inUseHint: Someone is holding this die in the current game.
KNUCKLES.builder.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? It disappears from every dropdown.
KNUCKLES.builder.deleteCopies: Delete {name}? It disappears from every dropdown, and {copies} copies are removed from {actors} characters.
KNUCKLES.builder.noItems: Dice become inventory items on Pathfinder 2e only. Here the die is fully playable; it just has no item to hand out.
KNUCKLES.builder.err.name: Give the die a name.
KNUCKLES.builder.err.icon: Pick an icon, so it never wears the stock die image.
KNUCKLES.builder.err.short: The face chances add up to less than 100%.
KNUCKLES.builder.err.over: The face chances add up to more than 100%.
KNUCKLES.builder.err.inUse: {name} is in play right now. End the game first, or take it out of that hand.
